summary: A Beaches dental office appears to lose new patients to a 2023 date and a live.com contact.

findings.problem: The page appears to carry a 2023 copyright date.
findings.cost: An old date tells a patient the office may not be active.

findings.problem: The doctor email appears to be a live.com address.
findings.cost: A free email gives less trust and can land in spam.
findings.fix: A clinic email on your own domain.

findings.problem: No text or WhatsApp option appears, only a phone number and a contact form.
findings.cost: Patients who want a quick answer message first.
findings.fix: A one tap text button and online booking.
